name: human-annotation-rescore-033

metric_policy.matching: one-to-one same-label point matching on human-supported labels with preserved original anchors
metric_policy.false_positive_policy: count only predictions whose label/event family was adjudicated for that window; ignore unresolved event families
metric_policy.duplicate_policy: unmatched duplicate predictions count as false positives
metric_policy.generic_label_policy: unknown point-value made/missed field goals are coverage gaps, not forced into two/three-point labels
metric_policy.boundary_policy: events whose reviewed action extends beyond original scored input are excluded from cached-input comparison

per_window.note: steal only; assist/turnover unresolved and made basket input incomplete
block missed; predicted two_point_miss is a generic-miss taxonomy coverage case, not scored here
first two_point_miss matched; rejected steal and turnover plus unmatched duplicate two_point_miss count false positive

interpretation: No model gain or regression is inferred. The full-original and adjudicated-slice metrics have different denominators. Changes are due to annotation/evaluator coverage, while cached model outputs are unchanged.
